methodologyNotes: Roster covers 10 currently sold high chairs spanning full-size, convertible, clip-on, and portable categories; two requested models (BabyBjorn High Chair, OXO Tot Seedling) were excluded because both are confirmed discontinued (BabyBjorn high chair phased out; OXO Tot Seedling discontinued ~2019) and no current USD MSRP exists. Primary sources are official manufacturer product pages (Stokke, IKEA, Chicco USA, Peg Perego, Nuna, Lalo, 4moms, Inglesina) and reputable retail product pages (Target, Babylist, MyStrollers, Buttercup Baby Store, PeppyParents, Amazon); prices represent published US MSRP or standard retail price at time of research. Booleans (true/false) indicate whether a feature is present as described by the manufacturer; weight_capacity_lb is a unitless number in pounds; all other string specs carry embedded units where applicable. Two specs were corrected against the draft after re-verification: Stokke Tripp Trapp max weight (242 lb per official Stokke spec, not 300) and Nuna ZAAZ max weight (220 lb manufacturer/retailer headline capacity, not 55). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Stokke Tripp Trapp
products.priceNote: MSRP, chair only; Baby Set, tray, and cushion sold separately
products.provenance: Price of $249 (chair only) confirmed on official Stokke USA product page. Weight capacity corrected from draft's 300 lb to 242 lb, the figure consistently cited by Stokke and retailers (chair grows with child up to 242 lb). 1972 launch year by designer Peter Opsvik confirmed via Stokke design history and Wikipedia. Chair does not recline and does not fold (solid wood). Tray sold separately.

products.name: Graco Blossom 6-in-1 Convertible High Chair
products.provenance: Price of $209.99 verified on Target product page (note: higher-cap booster modes reach 60 lb; high-chair mode caps at 40 lb). 40 lb high-chair capacity, 3-position recline, 6 height positions, leatherette seat, non-folding design, and removable tray confirmed via Target and Graco brand pages. Release year not published by manufacturer.

products.name: IKEA ANTILOP High Chair with Tray
products.provenance: Price $24.99 and 33 lb weight capacity confirmed on IKEA US product page. Polypropylene seat shell, removable tray, and steel legs confirmed. foldable=true reflects that legs detach for transport (no hinge fold mechanism, but designed to disassemble flat / be moved). Release year 1991 confirmed by IKEA Museum. No height adjustment or recline.

products.name: Lalo The Chair 3-in-1
products.priceNote: MSRP, current as listed on Babylist
products.provenance: Price $225 confirmed on Babylist listing. High-chair-mode weight capacity 30 lb confirmed via Lalo (play-chair mode supports more). Babylist explicitly states it does not fold for storage; no recline. Tray dishwasher-safe and removable. 3-in-1 version launched June 2022 per Momtastic/Motherly coverage.

products.name: Inglesina Fast Table Chair
products.priceNote: MSRP per Babylist listing (chair only; tray sold separately)
products.provenance: Price $79 (chair only) confirmed on Babylist; folds to 14x17x4 in confirmed. Weight capacity 37 lb and machine-washable padded fabric seat confirmed. Clip-on type (attaches to tables 0.8-3.5 in thick) confirmed via Amazon. Dining tray sold separately ($29). No recline, no height adjustment. Release year not found.

products.name: 4moms Connect High Chair
products.priceNote: MSRP per 4moms.com and Buttercup Baby Store
products.provenance: MSRP $299.99 confirmed on 4moms.com and Buttercup Baby Store. Weight capacity 60 lb, 3 height positions, magnetic one-handed tray, removable foam insert, and recline (supports newborns) confirmed. September 2021 launch (model 1042) confirmed via 4moms support.

products.name: Peg Perego Siesta High Chair
products.priceNote: MSRP per Peg Perego US and MyStrollers
products.provenance: Price $329.99 confirmed on Peg Perego US and MyStrollers (some retailers discount to ~$264). Weight capacity 45 lb, 5 recline positions (incl. lay-flat), 9 height positions, compact standing fold, and removable tray confirmed. Eco-leather (Prima Classe) seat confirmed on manufacturer page. Release year not found in public sources.

products.name: Chicco Polly High Chair
products.priceNote: MSRP per Chicco USA and Babylist
products.provenance: Price $159.99 confirmed on official Chicco USA product page (some retailers sell at $149.99). Weight capacity 40 lb, 3 recline positions, 7 height positions, compact 11 in fold that stands independently, and removable snap-on tray confirmed on Chicco USA. Soft wipeable fabric seat confirmed. Release year not determinable.

products.name: Summer Infant Pop 'n Sit Portable Highchair
products.provenance: Price ~$29.99 confirmed via multiple retailer listings (Amazon, Walmart). Weight capacity 45 lb (6 mo - 45 lb) confirmed on Amazon listing. Compact fold, machine-washable polyester fabric, removable BPA-free tray confirmed. No recline, no height adjustment. Release year not found.

products.name: Nuna ZAAZ High Chair
products.priceNote: MSRP per PeppyParents and Nuna USA

specs.seat_material: Air foam cushion (removable and washable), plastic shell

products.provenance: Price $299.95 confirmed on PeppyParents and Nuna USA. Weight capacity corrected from draft's 55 lb to 220 lb: the ZAAZ is a grow-with-me chair marketed to last into the teen years, and 220 lb is the headline structural capacity cited consistently by Nuna and retailers (Strolleria, Pish Posh, ANB, Bambi Baby). PeppyParents' 55 lb figure is an outlier likely referring to harness/active-restraint use. No recline and does not fold confirmed by multiple review sources. Hidden lift mechanism for height adjustment confirmed by Nuna. Air foam cushion seat confirmed. Release year not determinable.
